_comments.additionalProjects: Additional projects to add to the dropdown (in addition to backend database projects).
_comments.whitelist: Show ONLY these projects. Leave empty to show all.
_comments.blacklist: Hide these projects. Ignored if whitelist is set.
_comments.stac_replacement: STAC projects (names containing ' STAC') automatically replace legacy counterparts when the legacy version is filtered out. For example, if 'CMIP6' is blacklisted but 'CMIP6 STAC' is not, 'CMIP6 STAC' will display as 'CMIP6' (without the ' STAC' suffix). See projects.README.md for details.

show_only_cmip.description: Show only CMIP-related projects from both backend and additional sources

hide_legacy.description: Hide legacy or deprecated projects from any source

site_specific.description: Show only projects relevant to your institution

replace_legacy_with_stac.description: Retire legacy CMIP6 and replace with STAC version (displays as 'CMIP6' without ' STAC' suffix)

transition_period.description: During transition, show both legacy and STAC versions (both names visible for user choice)
transition_period.note: CMIP6 STAC will keep full name since legacy CMIP6 is also present
